name: Madhuban Kadamb
usps: Designed for affordable green living with thoughtfully crafted homes that stay within budget without compromising comfort.
Mixed-use convenience featuring 13 dedicated retail shop spaces on the ground floor to support everyday resident needs.
Pre-installed Adani Gas Pipeline supply provided for every unit.
Heat-reflective china mosaic laid on all terraces to enhance cooling.
Built with an earthquake-resistant RCC frame design ensuring superior structural seismic safety.
amenities: Temple, Chotaro (common sit-out), and landscaped garden spaces.
Jogging track, children's play area, and an outdoor amphitheater.
Equipped gymnasium, badminton court, and box cricket pitch.
Indoor game area including table tennis, plus a reading room and library.
Senior citizen's lounge, rooftop lounge, and yoga deck.
Community hall with kitchen, washroom, and store room.
EV-charging station, dedicated car wash area, and provision for stacked parking.
Gated premises with security cabin, CCTV surveillance, and fire safety systems.
target_audience: First-time homebuyers, young professionals, and budget-conscious families looking for an affordable, community-centric, mixed-use lifestyle near the commercial and industrial zones of Sarkhej, Sanand, and Changodar.
tagline: A place where life feels just right
